task: Predict whether an individual's income exceeds $50K per year using census data. The labels are binary: '<=50K' and '>50K'.

description.workclass: a general term to represent the employment status of an individual
description.fnlwgt: the number of units in the target population that the responding unit represents
description.education: the highest level of education achieved by an individual
description.education-num: the highest level of education achieved in numerical form
description.occupation: the general type of occupation of an individual
description.relationship: what this individual is relative to others
description.hours-per-week: the hours an individual has reported to work per week
